explanation: Asks for the set of k > 2 for which the pigeonhole bound (k−1)N is attained for every N ≥ k. Grebennikov–Kwan settle k > 10^37. Note that the July 2026 preprint of Ghosal–Goenka–Grebennikov–Keevash–Kwan–Pham (arXiv:2607.05255) states that for at most k per line with k ≥ 3, i.e. the file's k ≥ 4, the maximum is exactly kN for sufficiently large N. Because this question demands every N ≥ k, that result does not immediately settle it. The docstring could mention it. The formalization is well formed.
